contexts.text: His hairs white like the clean wool () = the Divine Natural as to truth. In the Word... truth itself was re [represented by white, which, being from good, is called clean wool. ( = His external good. AC 9470:3.)

By the wool of she-goats (, etc.) is signified the ultimate or outermost of innocence, which is in ignorance, such as there is with the gentiles. ( = the good that is from the good of mutual love. See Goat, at 9470.)
Thou shalt not wear wool and linen together (); wool = good, and linen, truth. AC 7601:8.
The worm shall eat them like wool ()... wool = the lower or exterior goods that are of the sensuous man.
That wool = truth from a celestial origin, which, in itself, is good. Illustrated.
My wool, and my flax () = the external goods of love and truths of faith.
Such truth as is in itself good, because it is the form of celestial good, is signified by wool, in , and in .
Wool = celestial truth, which, relatively, is good. And therefore it is said, in , that the priests... shall put on garments of linen, and no wool shall come upon them.

Wool = celestial truth, which is the truth of the good of love; and, as those who are in this truth cannot be in spiritual truth... it was ordered that no garment should be worn of mixed wool and linen. AC 10184:6. AC 10669:end. AE 951:7.
Wool = the exterior good of the Spiritual Church.
Wool = good in the external man.
The cows (in the Sixth Earth) are woolbearing, like sheep.
His head and His hairs were white as wool, like snow () = the Divine love of the Divine wisdom in primes and in ultimates. ( = as to the good and truth there. AE 67.)
It is said like wool, and like snow, because wool = good in ultimates, and snow, truth in ultimates; as also in ; for wool is from sheep, by which is signified the good of charity.
The man (of the Golden Age that we saw) was clad... in a tunic of white wool.
One of the two Angels wore a woollen robe that shone with flaming crimson.
Your reasoning is about goat's wool. 335-.
As the wool of a cloth is destroyed by moths.
The penalty of the woollen veil. SE 1373. SE 1410, General article. SE 3298.
Woolly. SE 4357.
White wool = good in ultimates... the reason of which is that the wool upon lambs and sheep has a signification like that of the hair upon man; and (these animals) = good. Illustrated.
The wool of Zachar () = natural good.
That sins... shall become as wool () = good.
